allowed_candidates.purpose: Keep local secrets and transient files out of the public shared-knowledge repository.
Keep the index namespace visible before generated indexes exist.
Keep the per-user namespace visible before team entries exist.
Keep the current RedCap user namespace visible before Norven publishes append-only entries.

version_binding.release_readiness_rule: Any future release-readiness claim must rerun live remote binding and arsenal-version-binding checks, then update this binding if the public worktree has intentionally advanced.

notes: This binding now covers the minimal public template surface plus RedCap Forge-reviewed append-only public entries and generated metadata indexes.
templates/shared-knowledge/ is the RedCap-internal template source and intentionally has no .git directory.
../redcap-arsenal is the preferred durable local public-library worktree for this installation.
Historical reports, lessons, identity files, runtime evidence, and host entry files remain out of scope unless RedCap Forge rewrites them into reviewed, deduplicated, safe public entries.
After any legitimate template or Forge entry push, update last_verified.remote_head and checked_at_utc by rerunning the live check; head drift is intentional fail-closed behavior.
